name: lying straight leg raise v. 2
description: A lying leg raise that targets the lower abs and hip flexors while you keep your legs long.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands under your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise both legs together until they point to the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
Keep your core braced and your back from arching.
